description: List the brand's knowledge-base items. short {id,name,contentType}; medium adds tags+summary+timestamps; full = raw. Filter by tag, active status, or global scope.

activeOnly.description: When true, only return active (non-soft-deleted) items. Defaults to true on the backend.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

global.description: When true, only return account-wide (isGlobal) items.

name: knowledge_list
